subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

Will not pass muster
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**, i.e., "Will not meet required standards". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Will not pass muster"** means something that does not meet the required standards or criteria. (आवश्यक मानकों को पूरा नहीं करता है) • **Example: **The proposal was rejected because it did not pass muster during the review process. • **"Meet required standards"** refers to fulfilling the necessary conditions or expectations for approval or acceptance. (आवश्यक मानकों को पूरा करना) • **Example: **Her work on the project passed muster and received praise from the team. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Will not bring any excitement** (कोई उत्साह नहीं लाएगा): Refers to something that fails to create enthusiasm or interest. • **Example:** The speech was dull and did not bring any excitement to the audience. • **Option 3: Will not escape attention** (ध्यान से बच नहीं पाएगा): Refers to something that is noticeable or cannot go unnoticed. • **Example: ** His extravagant outfit did not escape attention at the event. • **Option 4: Will not create any disturbance** (कोई गड़बड़ी नहीं पैदा करेगा): Refers to something that does not cause any disruption or interference. • **Example:** The team worked quietly and did not create any disturbance in the office. 4c:Ta09, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "Being involved or interfering in something".
